title: Holding my Grandson
synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.

fullText.simplified:
等了好久，医生终于出来了。王老太太赶紧去和医生要孙子。
    “用手术取出来的孩子，至少要在医院里住一个月。”医生说。
    “那么洗三怎么办呢？”王老太太问。
    “是命要紧，还是办洗三要紧呢？孕妇的肚子还没长好，怎么去见客人呢？”医生反问。
    王老太太确实觉得办洗三比人命要紧，可是又不便说出来，因为娘家妈在旁边听着呢。怎么见客人？那有办法：“叫她躺在床上见客人就好了，不用她起来。”
    医生还是不答应。王老太太知道了：“住院不就是为了要钱吗？好，我给你钱，让我们带上媳妇和孙子回家，总行了吧？”
    “你自己看看去，看她能不能走？”医生这么一说，两位老太太反倒都不敢去了。要是儿媳妇的肚子上还有一个大洞，那多让人害怕啊！
    还是娘家妈爱女儿，硬着头皮想去看看。王老太太也不好意思不跟着。
    到了病房，娘家妈看自己女儿躺在床上，脸就像一张白纸，肚子缝着线，不知道是死是活。娘家妈大声哭了起来。王老太太没有太大的感觉，只是看到儿媳妇不是平躺着，来了气：“怎么不让她平躺下来？这是在干什么？”
    “平躺着呀，肚子上缝的线就断了，懂了吗？”医生说。
    “那可以用胶水啊！”她总觉得医生没有什么聪明的办法。
    娘家妈想和女儿说说话，医生也不让。不管怎么说，孕妇大概一时是不能出院了。好吧，先把孙子抱走，回家好办洗三啊。医生也不答应。
    王老太太急了：“医院里能办洗三吗？要是能办的话，我就把亲朋好友全请到这里来；要是不能办，我就要抱走孙子。第一个大孙子，不办洗三，还有什么脸活着？”
    “谁给小孩奶吃？”医生问。
    “奶妈啊！”
    医生没话说了，王老太太终于把孙子抱了出来。
fullText.traditional:
等了好久，醫生終於出來了。王老太太趕緊去和醫生要孫子。
    “用手術取出來的孩子，至少要在醫院裡住一個月。”醫生說。
    “那麼洗三怎麼辦呢？”王老太太問。
    “是命要緊，還是辦洗三要緊呢？孕婦的肚子還沒長好，怎麼去見客人呢？”醫生反問。
    王老太太確實覺得辦洗三比人命要緊，可是又不便說出來，因為娘家媽在旁邊聽著呢。怎麼見客人？那有辦法：“叫她躺在床上見客人就好了，不用她起來。”
    醫生還是不答應。王老太太知道了：“住院不就是為了要錢嗎？好，我給你錢，讓我們帶上媳婦和孫子回家，總行了吧？”
    “你自己看看去，看她能不能走？”醫生這麼一說，兩位老太太反倒都不敢去了。要是兒媳婦的肚子上還有一個大洞，那多讓人害怕啊！
    還是娘家媽愛女兒，硬著頭皮想去看看。王老太太也不好意思不跟著。
    到了病房，娘家媽看自己女兒躺在床上，臉就像一張白紙，肚子縫著線，不知道是死是活。娘家媽大聲哭了起來。王老太太沒有太大的感覺，只是看到兒媳婦不是平躺著，來了氣：“怎麼不讓她平躺下來？這是在幹什麼？”
    “平躺著呀，肚子上縫的線就斷了，懂了嗎？”醫生說。
    “那可以用膠水啊！”她總覺得醫生沒有什麼聰明的辦法。
    娘家媽想和女兒說說話，醫生也不讓。不管怎麼說，孕婦大概一時是不能出院了。好吧，先把孫子抱走，回家好辦洗三啊。醫生也不答應。
    王老太太急了：“醫院裡能辦洗三嗎？要是能辦的話，我就把親朋好友全請到這裡來；要是不能辦，我就要抱走孫子。第一個大孫子，不辦洗三，還有什麼臉活著？”
    “誰給小孩奶吃？”醫生問。
    “奶媽啊！”
    醫生沒話說了，王老太太終於把孫子抱了出來。

raw.synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.
sentence_translations: After waiting quite a while, the doctor finally came out. Old Lady Wang hurriedly went to ask the doctor for her grandchild.
“When a baby is taken out by surgery, it is necessary to stay in the hospital for at least a month,” the doctor said.
“Then how can we hold the baby’s third-day bath party?” Old Lady Wang asked.
“Is life more important or is holding the baby’s third-day bath party more important?
The pregnant woman’s belly still hasn’t grown back. How can she see the guests?” the doctor countered.
Old Lady Wang indeed thought that holding the baby’s third-day bath party was more important than a human life, ..
.. but she also felt that it was inappropriate to say so, because her daughter-in-law’s mother was beside her listening.
How can she see the guests? Well there is a way, “Tell her to lie in bed to see the guests, she doesn’t need to get up.”
The doctor still did not agree. Old Lady Wang was wise to this, ..
.. “Isn’t hospitalization just because you want money? Okay, I will give you money.
Let us take my daughter-in-law and grandson home, that must be okay, right?”
“Go and take a look at her yourself and see if she is able to go.”
When the doctor said this, the two elderly ladies actually didn’t dare to go.
If the daughter-in-law’s belly still had a big hole in it, that would be really scary!
Nevertheless the daughter-in-law’s mother loved her daughter. She summoned up the courage to go and see her.
Old Lady Wang had no choice but to also follow along.
Arriving on the ward, the daughter-in-law’s mother saw her own daughter lying on the bed, ..
.. her face looking like a sheet of white paper.
Her belly had been stitched together with thread and she didn’t know if she was dead or alive.
Her mother wailed loudly.
Old Lady Wang didn’t feel much. She only saw that her daughter-in-law was not lying flat, and became angry, ..
“Why didn’t you make her lie flat? What are you doing?”
“If she lies down flat, the thread that has been stitched on her belly will snap, do you understand?” the doctor said.
“Then you can use glue!” She persisted in thinking that the doctor didn’t have any clever methods.
The daughter-in-law’s mother wanted to talk to her daughter, but the doctor wouldn’t let her.
In any case, the pregnant woman would not be able to be discharged for some time.
Alright, first we’ll take the grandson back home for the baby’s third-day bath party. The doctor still refused.
Old Lady Wang became anxious, ..
.. “Can the baby’s third-day bath party be held in the hospital?
If it can be held in the hospital, I will invite all of my friends and family to come here.
If it cannot be held in the hospital, I must take my grandson away.
My first big grandson. If the baby’s third-day bath party is not held, I will not have the face to carry on living.”
“Who will feed milk to the baby?” the doctor asked.
“A wet nurse!”
The doctor had nothing to say. Old Lady Wang finally took her grandson away.
